contentBlocks.title: SRD R370 Grant Payment Methods — Bank Transfer vs Cash Send
contentBlocks.description: Learn how the SRD R370 grant pays out each month. Choose between direct bank EFT transfer to your personal account or Cash Send retail collection at Shoprite, Pick n Pay, Boxer, Checkers, and Usave — no bank account needed for cash collection. Our guide covers switching methods, processing timelines, and what to do if your payment is delayed.

contentBlocks.text: The SRD R370 grant can be paid through two methods: direct bank transfer (EFT) to your personal bank account, or Cash Send (retail collection) where you collect cash at a store. You do not need a bank account to receive the grant — Cash Send works with just your ID and a cellphone.

SASSA deposits your grant directly into your personal South African bank account. Payments are processed between the 25th and last day of each month. Funds typically reflect 1 to 3 business days after processing, depending on your bank.

contentBlocks.title: Bank Account Requirements
contentBlocks.text: The bank account MUST be registered in your own name and match your ID exactly. SASSA will not pay into third-party accounts. Your account must be active and support EFT deposits.

Cash Send allows you to collect your grant in cash at any participating retailer without a bank account. When your payment is processed, you receive an SMS voucher with a unique collection code. Take this SMS and your ID to any participating store to collect your cash.

items: Pick n Pay — all branches nationwide

steps.title: Wait for the SMS voucher
steps.description: SASSA sends an SMS with a unique collection voucher code. Do not go to the store until you receive this SMS.

steps.title: Go to any participating retailer
steps.description: Take your phone showing the SMS and your original ID document to any Pick n Pay, Shoprite, Boxer, Checkers, or Usave.

steps.title: Present your ID and voucher code
steps.description: Tell the cashier you are collecting a SASSA Cash Send. Provide your ID and the voucher code from the SMS.

steps.title: Receive your cash
steps.description: The cashier will verify your details and hand you R370 in cash. Count it before leaving the counter.

contentBlocks.title: Cash Send SMS Expiry
contentBlocks.text: The SMS voucher expires within 7 to 10 days. If you do not collect your grant within this period, the voucher expires and you will need to contact SASSA to request a new one.
How to Switch Between Payment Methods
You can switch between bank transfer and Cash Send at any time. Changes take effect from the following month's payment.

steps.title: Log into the SRD portal
steps.description: Go to srd.sassa.gov.za and log in with your ID and phone number.

steps.title: Go to 'Payment Method'
steps.description: Navigate to the payment method section on your dashboard.

steps.title: Select your new method
steps.description: Choose 'Bank Transfer' or 'Cash Send' depending on your preference.

steps.title: If switching to bank: enter your details
steps.description: Provide your bank name, account number, branch code, and account type. The account must be in your name.

steps.title: Confirm the change
steps.description: Review your selection and confirm. The change will apply from the next month.

faqs.question: Can I receive SRD without a bank account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select 'Cash Send' as your payment method. You collect your R370 in cash at any Pick n Pay, Shoprite, Boxer, Checkers, or Usave using an SMS voucher.

faqs.question: How long after approval does the payment take?
faqs.answer: Payments are processed between the 25th and last day of each month. Bank transfers take 1-3 business days to reflect. Cash Send SMS vouchers arrive within 24-48 hours of processing.

faqs.question: My SRD payment is not reflecting in my account. What do I do?
faqs.answer: First check your status on the SRD portal. If it says 'Approved' or 'Payment Processing', wait 1-3 business days. If it still does not appear after 5 business days, check your bank details are correct or contact SASSA.

faqs.question: Can I use someone else's bank account?
faqs.answer: No. SASSA strictly requires the bank account to be registered in your own name. Payments into third-party accounts are not allowed.

faqs.question: Can I collect my grant at any retailer?
faqs.answer: Yes, any Pick n Pay, Shoprite, Boxer, Checkers, or Usave branch nationwide can process your Cash Send collection.
